**1) LAYOUT**
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized, Windows 11 style).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 to 1024, 45):** Contains app icon/title (left), and window controls (right).
*   **Toolbar Cluster (0, 45 to 1024, 115):** Navigation buttons (left), Address/Breadcrumb bar (center-left), View/Filter/Search controls (right).
*   **Main Content Area (0, 115 to 1024, 855):** Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Tree Pane (Left):** (0, 130 to 280, 840). Contains Path/Type tabs and a directory tree.
    *   **File List Pane (Center):** (285, 130 to 795, 840). Contains column headers and a scrollable list of items.
    *   **Preview/Details Pane (Right):** (800, 130 to 1024, 840). Displays metadata and a large action button for the selected item.
*   **Status Bar / CTA Footer (0, 855 to 1024, 950):** Full-width banner containing scan status (left) and primary action (right).
*   **Windows Taskbar (0, 950 to 1024, 768):** Standard OS taskbar at the bottom.

**2) TEXT (Verbatim)**
*   **Title Bar:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Toolbar Button:** "Buy Now"
*   **Address Bar:** "Windows (C:)"
*   **Search Box Placeholder:** "Search files or folders"
*   **Tabs:** "Path", "Type"
*   **Column Headers:** "Name", "Date Modified", "Type"
*   **Tree Items:**

**3) COLOR (Estimated Hex)**
*   **App Background:** `#F5F8FA` (Light blue-grey)
*   **Surface/Pane Backgrounds:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Selected Row Background:** `#E6F2FF` (Very light blue)
*   **Primary Button (Buy Now/Recover):** Gradient from `#FFB800` to `#FF9500` (Orange/Yellow); Blue variant for Recover `#1677FF`.
*   **Primary Text:** `#333333` or `#1F1F1F`
*   **Secondary/Muted Text:** `#666666` or `#8C8C8C`
*   **Link/Accent Text (Tab active):** `#1677FF`
*   **Borders/Separators:** `#E8E8E8` or `#D9D9D9`
*   **Icon Accent (Checkmark):** `#52C41A` (Green)

**4) TYPOGRAPHY (Estimates)**
*   **Title Bar:** Segoe UI, ~11px, Regular.
*   **Address Bar/Breadcrumbs:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular.
*   **Column Headers:** Segoe UI, ~12px, Medium.
*   **List Items (Name):** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular.
*   **List Items (Meta):** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Preview Title ("ghcup"):** Segoe UI, ~14px, Medium.
*   **Status Bar Text:** Segoe UI, ~14px, Semi-bold (for numbers).

**5) SPACING & SIZING**
*   **Row Height (List):** ~42px per row.
*   **Control Height (Buttons/Search):** ~32-36px.
*   **Padding (Panes):** ~12-16px internal padding.
*   **Gutter (Pane separation):** ~4-6px.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Buttons: ~4-6px.
    *   Search/Input fields: ~6px (pill-like or rounded rect).
    *   Tabs: ~6px top corners.
*   **Icon Size (List):** 24x24px or 32x32px (Folder icons).
*   **Checkbox Size:** 16x16px.

**6) CONTROLS & STATES**
*   **Navigation Buttons:** Home, Back (Disabled/Greyed), Forward (Disabled/Greyed), Up.
*   **Breadcrumb:** Dropdown trigger on right side of path.
*   **View Toggle:** Hamburger/List icon (Selected state: Blue background/text).
*   **Filter Button:** Funnel icon + "Filter" text.
*   **Search Input:** Text field with magnifying glass icon (right aligned).
*   **Tabs:** "Path" (Active/Selected - White bg, Blue text), "Type" (Inactive - Grey bg).
*   **Tree View:** Expand/Collapse arrows (chevrons). Checkboxes next to items. "Windows (C:)" is expanded.
*   **List View:**
    *   **Header:** Sort indicator (up arrow) on "Name".
    *   **Rows:** Checkbox (unchecked), Folder Icon, Name, Date, Type.
    *   **Selection State:** Row "ghcup" is selected (Blue highlight background).
*   **Preview Pane:** Large "Open" button (Light Blue background).
*   **Footer:** "Recover All ..." button (Solid Blue, Primary CTA).

**7) ICONOGRAPHY**
*   **Style:** Fluent Design / Windows 11 style. Mix of Outline (Nav, Toolbar) and Filled (Folder icons in list).
*   **Weights:** Stroke width ~1.5px for outline icons.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   Folders: Standard Windows 11 yellow/blue folder glyph.
    *   Checkmarks: Green circle with white check (Success state).

**8) STATE**
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Populated**. The scan has finished ("Scan Completed"), and results are displayed.
*   **Selection State:** The file/folder "ghcup" is currently selected in the list view, triggering the details preview in the right pane.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot). Scrollbar on the file list indicates more content below.
